cohort: 1054 singleton live fetuses in breech presentation
finding: The induction rates were stable during the study period and there was no significant difference in intrapartum cesarean section rates, in the frequency of pH <7.0 in the umbilical artery, or in the frequency of metabolic acidosis when comparing induced and spontaneous breech deliveries.
mod_finding: This study compared outcomes of induced and spontaneous breech deliveries and found no significant difference in intrapartum cesarean section rates between the two groups.
